title: Eliciting Uncertainty in Chain-of-Thought to Mitigate Bias against Forecasting Harmful User Behaviors

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating statistical bias (the expected difference between predicted and actual outcomes) to measure the systematic under-prediction of personal attacks in conversation forecasting tasks.

Evaluating how the statistical bias in forecasting personal attacks fluctuates across different LLM-extracted conversation topics (e.g., 'Ethics and Morality', 'Social Issues', 'Politics and Law') to see if under-prediction severity depends on the subject matter.
